groups.rationale: Merged upstream Antithesis ADR0160 ordinary-read and privileged-mutation oracle corrections, scanner164 count and multi-user CI Nix with reviewed native partial state. Chapter17 keeps current prerequisites and source/runtime distinctions; no new hosted or native execution claims and admission remains disabled.

Reviewed merged Chapter08 upgraded WebSocket idle lifetime and shared Chapters17/19 with retained native scenarios and signed-cache scenario. Marshall source and domain ownership are unchanged by this merge; exact native evidence and remaining boot, isolation and fleet gaps remain intact.

Protocol source and all-false native capability rows are unchanged. Reviewed shared Chapter08 socket lifetime, Chapter17 verification wording and regenerated scenario coverage after merging upstream cache policy with native attestation evidence; none widens protocol schemas, boot authority or runtime acceptance.

Lilly source and jail-local native attestation/readiness boundaries are unchanged. Reviewed cache trust and publication configuration documentation, merged native and signed-cache scenarios and shared verification chapters; synthetic, evaluated, diagnostic and native execution scopes remain distinct and admission remains disabled.

Reviewed Audi explicit60-second upgraded WebSocket client idle timeout and regression against Chapter08 lease and peer-close authority; listener5-second HTTP timeout is separate. Retained native Lyra service/growth/recovery evidence and gaps in Chapters17/19/20; no native source or acceptance changed.

Fleet machine-test wrappers that run lilly eval as root now export LILLY_SERVICE_UID, as the zfs-guest wrapper already does, so fixtures can read Lilly-owned private files (the 0600 lilly-owned /run/lilly-release/config.json) under always-unprivileged Lilly (ADR-0182); test harness only, no documented behaviour changes.

Preserved upstream accepted partial ADR0188 signed substitution and ADR0189 scoped fleet publishing with native ADR0190 and reciprocal0180 supersession. Semantically merged161 scenario IDs, retained native reset/service/growth/recovery gaps and corrected cache scenario publication custody to match ADR0189; regenerated coverage. Upstream Audi/Hegel/access reviews retain their execution scope without new native acceptance.
